name: Graph Signal Denoising and Trend Filtering
shortfall_explanation: No complete matching GPU graph-signal denoising solver was verified. Sparse fused-lasso primitives and learned node classifiers do not establish the specified denoising objective.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.

algorithms.algorithm_name: Graph trend filtering via specialized ADMM
algorithms.notes: Section 4.1 of the paper. The authors' MATLAB/R reference software is CPU code and is not substituted for GPU code.

algorithms.algorithm_name: Graph trend filtering via projected Newton
algorithms.notes: Section 4.2 of the same paper. A distinct solver from ADMM; no local GPU implementation was written.

This is sparse fused lasso, not an ADMM implementation. The Gunrock report finds a serial normalization bottleneck and no multi-GPU benefit. Extra vertex sparsity penalty differs from the default TV contract. Retained for research, not recommended as a proven GPU speedup.
